The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, St. Gallen; other communes in St. Gallen set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).

sections.title: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (St. Gallen)

rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: Every municipality (property tax, Grundsteuer), on real estate of natural and legal persons

rows.label: Rate for tax-exempt legal entities whose property directly serves public or charitable purposes

source.title: St. Gallen Steuergesetz (sGS 811.1), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Grundsteuer

sections.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).

sections.title: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (St. Gallen)

rows.label: Reduced rate
rows.value: Half the rate for transfers between parents and their children (including adopted, step- and foster children) and between siblings dividing the parents' estate

source.title: St. Gallen Steuergesetz (sGS 811.1), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Art. 245

sections.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
